words.example: The seller is absolutely unwilling to waive the non-compete clause.
words.exampleZh: 賣方完全不願意放棄競業禁止條款。
words.notes: 程度副詞，表示完全、絕對。

words.example: The buyer asked us to accelerate the acquisition timetable.
words.exampleZh: 買方要求我們加快收購時程。
words.notes: 後面可接計畫、步伐或進度。

words.example: Investors acclaimed the spin-off after the first trading day.
words.exampleZh: 第一個交易日之後，投資人稱讚這次分割。
words.notes: 公開稱讚。作名詞是喝彩、讚譽。

words.example: Without board approval, we cannot accomplish the property transfer.
words.exampleZh: 沒有董事會核准，我們無法完成這次財產移轉。
words.notes: 把事情做完。後面接受詞。

words.example: Neither side should accuse the other of hiding debt before the audit.
words.exampleZh: 查帳之前，雙方都不該指控對方隱匿債務。
words.notes: accuse somebody of something，指控某人做了某事。

words.example: The buyer plans to acquire the target's customer list with the shares.
words.exampleZh: 買方計畫隨股份一併取得目標公司的客戶名單。
words.notes: 取得資產、公司，也可以是學到技能。

words.example: The acquisition of the plant is scheduled to close in June.
words.exampleZh: 這座工廠的收購預定六月交割。
words.notes: 在這個單元裡常指收購。也可以泛指取得。

words.example: The integration team must take action on the overlapping contracts this week.
words.exampleZh: 整合小組這個星期必須處理那些重疊的合約。
words.notes: take action 是採取行動。法律上 action 也可以指訴訟。

words.example: The actual headcount is lower than the figure in the teaser.
words.exampleZh: 實際人數比招商簡報上的數字少。
words.notes: actual situation 是實際情況。

words.example: Their adherence to the competition rules delayed the closing.
words.exampleZh: 他們遵守競爭規範，因此交割延後了。
words.notes: adherence to 是遵守、堅持某一套規則。

words.example: We will adjust the earn-out if this year's revenue misses the target.
words.exampleZh: 如果今年營收沒有達標，我們會調整或有對價。
words.notes: 調整計畫、數字或自己去適應。

words.example: The board voted to adopt the merger proposal and drop the solo bid.
words.exampleZh: 董事會表決採用合併方案，並放棄單獨出價。
words.notes: 採用建議、計畫或做法。另一個意思是收養。

words.example: These regional sales aggregate to the total in the merger model.
words.exampleZh: 這些區域銷售合計後就是合併模型裡的總數。
words.notes: 作動詞是加總。作名詞或形容詞時是總計、合計的。

words.example: The other side will not agree to a breakup fee above that cap.
words.exampleZh: 對方不會同意高於那個上限的破局費。
words.notes: agree to 同意某事。agree with 同意某人。

words.example: Sign the agreement only after the disclosure schedule is complete.
words.exampleZh: 揭露附表完成之後才簽協議。
words.notes: 可以是協議這份文件，也可以是雙方同意這件事。

words.example: They may alter the payment waterfall before signing.
words.exampleZh: 簽約前他們可能會更改付款順序。
words.notes: 改變條款或內容。和 modify 相近。

words.example: The buyer will not annex the subsidiary if the land title is unclear.
words.exampleZh: 如果土地權狀不清楚，買方不會兼併這家子公司。
words.notes: 可以是兼併，也可以是把文件附上。

words.example: The seller asserted that all tax filings are current.
words.exampleZh: 賣方聲稱所有稅務申報都是最新的。
words.notes: assert that 是聲稱。assert a right 是主張權利。

words.example: The assignee may collect the receivables after the notice is sent.
words.exampleZh: 通知寄出之後，受讓人可以收取這些應收款。
words.notes: 接受權利或合約轉讓的人。出讓人是 assignor。

words.example: The CFO could not assure investors that no debt was left off the books.
words.exampleZh: 財務長無法向投資人保證帳上沒有漏列債務。
words.notes: assure someone that 是向某人保證。

words.example: The combined firm may not attain the savings stated in the model.
words.exampleZh: 合併後的公司未必達得到模型裡寫的節省金額。
words.notes: attain a goal 是達到目標。

words.example: Our attorney will review the merger filing before it goes out.
words.exampleZh: 我們的律師會在申報送出前審一遍。
words.notes: 美式英語裡 attorney 常指律師。也可以是法定代理人。

words.example: They walked away from a target that was near bankruptcy.
words.exampleZh: 他們放棄了一家瀕臨破產的目標公司。
words.notes: declare bankruptcy 是宣告破產。

words.example: The transfer is basically a sale of shares, not of each asset.
words.exampleZh: 這次轉讓基本上是出售股份，不是逐項出售資產。
words.notes: 基本上、大體上。

words.example: The integration blueprint does not mention the overseas warehouse.
words.exampleZh: 整合藍圖沒有提到海外倉庫。
words.notes: 原指設計圖。商業上常指行動方案。

words.example: Combining the two sales teams will be a challenging job.
words.exampleZh: 把兩個業務團隊合在一起會是一件有挑戰性的工作。
words.notes: 困難但值得做。

words.example: A coalition of minority shareholders asked for a higher offer.
words.exampleZh: 少數股東結盟，要求提高出價。
words.notes: 為了同一目的站在一起的一方。

words.example: After a week of cogitation, the board dropped the hostile bid.
words.exampleZh: 慎重考慮了一個星期之後，董事會放棄了敵意出價。
words.notes: 仔細想。和 consideration 相近，但這個字比較少見。

words.example: The offer period will commence on the day the circular is posted.
words.exampleZh: 要約期間會在通知函寄出當天開始。
words.notes: 正式用語，意思是開始。

words.example: The chair commended the team for finding the missing lien.
words.exampleZh: 主席稱讚小組找出了漏列的留置權。
words.notes: commend someone for 是因某事稱讚某人。

words.example: We want a competitive price, but not one that starves the new company.
words.exampleZh: 我們想要有競爭力的價格，但不要把新公司做虧。
words.notes: competitive advantage 是競爭優勢。

words.example: Financing remains a condition of the closing.
words.exampleZh: 融資仍然是交割的一項條件。
words.notes: 作「條件」時可數。on condition that 是在某條件下。

words.example: They contemplate merging the two plants within a year.
words.exampleZh: 他們考慮在一年內把兩座工廠合併。
words.notes: 後面可接名詞或動名詞，表示仔細考慮。

words.example: Talks will continue after the data room reopens.
words.exampleZh: 資料室重新開放之後，談判會繼續。
words.notes: continue to do 和 continue doing 都是繼續做。

words.example: Shareholders defeated the proposal to sell the brand alone.
words.exampleZh: 股東否決了單獨出售品牌的提案。
words.notes: 作動詞是擊敗。作名詞是失敗。

words.example: The disclosure letter explains every detail of the pending lawsuit.
words.exampleZh: 揭露函說明了這件未決訴訟的每個細節。
words.notes: in detail 是詳細地。detail 也可以作動詞，表示詳述。

words.example: A drastic drop in orders led them to merge the two divisions.
words.exampleZh: 訂單劇烈下滑，使他們把兩個部門合併。
words.notes: 變化很大、手段很猛。

words.example: The non-compete will be enforced for two years after closing.
words.exampleZh: 競業禁止條款在交割後會強制執行兩年。
words.notes: 使規定真正發生效力。

words.example: The escrow ensures that the seller cannot remove cash before closing.
words.exampleZh: 託管帳戶確保賣方不能在交割前把現金拿走。
words.notes: ensure that 是確保。投保較常用 insure。

words.example: They do not plan to expand the product line during the first year.
words.exampleZh: 他們不打算在第一年擴大產品線。
words.notes: 後面可接規模、版圖或名詞。

words.example: The buyer failed to disclose a change of control in the lease.
words.exampleZh: 買方沒有揭露租約裡的控制權變更。
words.notes: fail to do 是沒有做成。

words.example: A failure to obtain approval will terminate the merger agreement.
words.exampleZh: 如果沒有取得核准，合併協議就終止。
words.notes: 失敗這件事。合約裡較少用來指失敗者。

words.example: The talks made little headway until the price gap narrowed.
words.exampleZh: 價差縮小之前，談判幾乎沒有進展。
words.notes: make headway 是有進展。

words.example: They will incorporate the new holding company in Taiwan.
words.exampleZh: 他們會在台灣設立這家新的控股公司。
words.notes: 可以是設立公司，也可以是把一方併入另一方。

words.example: An instantaneous reply would show that we have not read the accounts.
words.exampleZh: 立刻回覆會顯得我們還沒看過帳冊。
words.notes: 馬上發生的。

words.example: They intend to purchase the plant, not merely license the brand.
words.exampleZh: 他們打算買下工廠，不是只授權品牌。
words.notes: intend to do 是打算做。

words.example: Please itemize the liabilities that will transfer with the shares.
words.exampleZh: 請逐項列出將隨股份移轉的負債。
words.notes: 一項一項寫出來。

words.example: Each party should ask its own lawyer to read the share purchase agreement.
words.exampleZh: 每一方都應該請自己的律師閱讀股權買賣協議。
words.notes: hire a lawyer 是聘請律師。

words.example: What does this earn-out clause mean for next year's bonus pool?
words.exampleZh: 這條或有對價條款對明年的獎金池是什麼意思？
words.notes: 意思是、意指。後面可接名詞或 that 子句。

words.example: The synergy figure is meaningless without a source for the savings.
words.exampleZh: 如果說不出節省從哪裡來，那個綜效數字就沒有意義。
words.notes: 沒有意義、不能說明什麼。

words.example: The two sales companies will merge into one legal entity.
words.exampleZh: 這兩家銷售公司會合併成一個法人。
words.notes: merge into 併入。merge with 與……合併。

words.example: Signing the term sheet was the first milestone, not the closing.
words.exampleZh: 簽署條款清單是第一個里程碑，還不是交割。
words.notes: 重要的進度點。

words.example: They accepted a modest price in exchange for a cleaner balance sheet.
words.exampleZh: 他們接受一個不過分的價格，換一份比較乾淨的資產負債表。
words.notes: 數量或程度不過高。也可以是謙遜的。

words.example: The signing photo showed both chairs in dark suits and neckties.
words.exampleZh: 簽約照片裡兩位主席都穿著深色西裝、打著領帶。
words.notes: 領帶。複數是 neckties。

words.example: Our opponent in the bid raised the price on the last day.
words.exampleZh: 競標對手在最後一天提高了價格。
words.notes: 競爭或對立的一方。

words.example: At the outset, both sides agreed that the brand would stay.
words.exampleZh: 一開始雙方就同意品牌會保留。
words.notes: at the outset 和 from the outset 都是從一開始。

words.example: The letter does not name any particular contract that must be assigned.
words.exampleZh: 這封信沒有指出哪一份特定合約必須轉讓。
words.notes: 作形容詞是特定的、特別的。作名詞時 particulars 常指詳細資料。

words.example: The seller refused to particularize the customer complaints in writing.
words.exampleZh: 賣方拒絕用書面逐項說明客戶抱怨。
words.notes: 把事情一項項講清楚。

words.example: We need a written plan for which contracts transfer on day one.
words.exampleZh: 我們需要一份書面計畫，寫明第一天要移轉哪些合約。
words.notes: 這裡是名詞。plan 也可以作動詞，表示計畫。

words.example: Head office will program the first month of integration before closing.
words.exampleZh: 總公司會在交割前安排好第一個月的整合工作。
words.notes: 作動詞是規劃、安排。作名詞也可以指程式或節目。

words.example: The integration project starts the morning after closing.
words.exampleZh: 整合專案在交割後的第二天早上開始。
words.notes: 一件有目標、有期限的工作。

words.example: The first month's orders look promising, but the data room was thin.
words.exampleZh: 第一個月的訂單看來有希望，但資料室的資料不多。
words.notes: 未來可能不錯。

words.example: The main prospect of this deal is a larger distribution network.
words.exampleZh: 這筆交易的主要前景是更大的經銷網路。
words.notes: 前景、展望。複數 prospects 很常用。另一個意思是景色。

words.example: Their purpose in buying the shares is to control the brand.
words.exampleZh: 他們買下股份的目的是控制品牌。
words.notes: for the purpose of 是為了。

words.example: The definition section is the reference for every capitalized term.
words.exampleZh: 定義那一節是每個大寫用語的參照。
words.notes: for reference 是供參考。

words.example: The regulator may revoke the approval if the merger reduces competition.
words.exampleZh: 如果合併減少競爭，主管機關可以撤銷核准。
words.notes: 正式取消已經給出的許可或決定。

words.example: Only the chair thinks this financing scheme will pass the bank.
words.exampleZh: 只有主席認為這個融資方案會通過銀行。
words.notes: 計畫、方案。有時帶貶義，指計謀。

words.example: The union's stance is that no plant will close in the first year.
words.exampleZh: 工會的立場是第一年不關閉任何工廠。
words.notes: 對某事採取的立場或態度。

words.example: The buyer wants a formal statement that the tax returns are complete.
words.exampleZh: 買方要一份正式聲明，說明稅務申報是完整的。
words.notes: make a statement 是發表聲明。

words.example: They succeeded in moving the key contracts before the closing.
words.exampleZh: 他們在交割前成功移轉了關鍵合約。
words.notes: succeed in doing 是成功做成。

words.example: The success of the merger depends on keeping the sales managers.
words.exampleZh: 這次合併是否成功，取決於能不能留下業務主管。
words.notes: 成功這件事或成功的結果。

words.example: A successful signing still leaves the integration work ahead.
words.exampleZh: 簽約順利完成，整合工作還在後面。
words.notes: 做成了、結果好的。

words.example: The target company will keep its name for at least two years.
words.exampleZh: 目標公司至少會再用兩年現在的名字。
words.notes: 目標。收購裡 target company 是被收購的公司。

words.example: They will transfer the trademarks to the new holding company.
words.exampleZh: 他們會把商標轉讓給新的控股公司。
words.notes: 轉讓權利、股份或把東西移到別處。

words.example: The court set a trial date that falls before the long-stop date.
words.exampleZh: 法院排定的審判日期落在最後截止日之前。
words.notes: 可以是審判，也可以是試驗。trial period 是試用期。

words.example: The notary acted as a witness when the shares were transferred.
words.exampleZh: 股份移轉時，公證人擔任見證人。
words.notes: 在場證明某事的人。in witness of 是為了證明。
